supersedes_for_current_state.note: Seal draft (written 2026-10-15T10:28:09Z, before diagnosis concluded) is retained as a historical draft, NOT overwritten. This R1 decision supersedes it as the current terminal-state record, per the repair clause.

defect.statement: BaselineAgentV2 sent transposed ACTION6 coordinates: candidates are (row, col)=(y, x) derived from the frame array, but the code unpacked `x, y = t[idx % len(t)]`, sending {"x": row, "y": col}. The engine convention is {"x": col, "y": row} (x=column, y=row; (0,0) top-left), so every explainable click landed on the transposed pixel.
defect.class: mechanical convention defect; one line; affects 100% of ACTION6 payloads that used explainable candidates

engine_source_chain: arcengine/camera.py `_raw_render`: sprite pixels placed at output[sprite.y+py, sprite.x+px]; `display_to_grid(display_x, display_y) -> (grid_x, grid_y)` with x=column, y=row.
arcengine/level.py `get_sprite_at`: x>=sprite.x, y>=sprite.y; sprite pixels indexed pixels[y-sprite.y][x-sprite.x].

arcengine/base_game.py: engine-generated valid ACTION6 clicks use {'x': (sprite.x+px)*scale+x_offset, 'y': (sprite.y+py)*scale+y_offset}; the agent-visible frame is `camera.render()` (frame[row=y][col=x]).

live_probe_static.result: 4/4 click-capable games probed (sp80, m0r0, ar25, lp85): correct {'x': col, 'y': row} is in the engine valid-click set and resolves to the clickable sprite; the transposed payload resolves to None (no sprite).

live_probe_replay.result: pre-fix baseline deterministic replay: 100% of sampled ACTION6 sends equal (row, col) as (x, y) i.e. transposed; ACTION6 rates: lp85 1.000/step (1200/1200), sp80 0.0125, cd82 0.0017.

fix_verify.result: post-fix: sent==(col,row) in 22/22 sp80 + 1500/1500 lp85 checks; intended pixel non-background 95.5% / 86.1%; pre-fix payload targeted the intended pixel only 45.5% / 33.5% of the time.

dynamic_probe.result: level-1 click frame effects are inconclusive (cosmetic/no-op for probed sprites); recorded for completeness, not used for the verdict.
